alerts.title: Heat Advisory
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 108 expected.

* WHERE...Central Oklahoma.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM CDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat illnesses.

alerts.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
alerts.description: THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE HAS ISSUED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 412 IN EFFECT UNTIL 9 PM CDT THIS EVENING.

alerts.title: Tornado Warning
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Tornado Warning for Central Oklahoma County in central Oklahoma.

* WHEN...Until 2:45 PM CDT.

* HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

* IMPACTS...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows.

alerts.title: Flash Flood Warning
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Oklahoma City metro.

* WHEN...Until 5:00 PM CDT.

alerts.title: Special Weather Statement
alerts.description: A strong thunderstorm will impact portions of Logan County through 2:30 PM CDT.
